jei.fastfurnacev2.iron_fast_crusher: 200% speed (250% with Lava-Infused Coal; 300% with Lava-Infused Coal) and a 15% chance to double the complete result.

jei.fastfurnacev2.diamond_fast_crusher: 300% speed (350% with Lava-Infused Coal; 400% with Lava-Infused Coal) and a 25% chance to double the complete result.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_cobblestone: Mining stone without Silk Touch has a 10% chance to also drop Lava-Infused Cobblestone, +5% per Fortune level.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_coal: Mining coal ore without Silk Touch has a 10% chance to also drop Lava-Infused Coal, +5% per Fortune level. In Lava-Infused Furnaces and Crushers, burns 50–125% longer and adds 50 percentage points of speed.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_coal_block: Receives Lava-Infused Coal's speed and burn-duration bonuses in Lava-Infused Furnaces and Crushers.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extreme_coal_ore: Coal ore has a 5% chance to be replaced by Lava-Infused Coal Ore.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extreme_coal: Doubles Lava-Infused Coal's speed and burn-duration bonuses in Lava-Infused Furnaces and Crushers. Supplies 7,200 Accelerator work at 5× speed.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extreme_coal_block: Receives Lava-Infused Coal's speed and burn-duration bonuses in Lava-Infused Furnaces and Crushers. Supplies 8,000 Accelerator work at 5× speed.
jei.fastfurnacev2.deepslate_extreme_coal: Deepslate coal ore has a 5% chance to be replaced by Deepslate Lava-Infused Coal Ore.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_ore: Matching ores have a 5% chance to be replaced by their Lava-Infused variants.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_iron_tool: Iron tool with 20% faster block breaking.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_gold_tool: Golden tool with 30% faster block breaking.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_diamond_tool: Diamond tool with 20% faster block breaking and a 5% chance to avoid durability damage.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_diamond_sword: Diamond sword with 20% faster attacks, 20% more attack damage, and a 5% chance to avoid durability damage.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extremely_fast_tool: Twice diamond-tool durability, 50% faster block breaking, built-in Fortune II, and a 5% chance to double block drops.
jei.fastfurnacev2.extremely_fast_sword: Twice diamond-sword durability, 50% faster attacks, built-in Looting II, a 5% chance to double kill drops, and a 10% chance to deal double damage.
jei.fastfurnacev2.accelerator_info: Requires lava on all four horizontal sides. Lava-Infused Coal and its block provide 3× processing speed; Lava-Infused Coal and its block provide 5×.
jei.fastfurnacev2.alloyer_info: Uses only Lava-Infused Coal. Each horizontal lava side reduces processing time by 100 ticks.
jei.fastfurnacev2.generator_info: Generates %s FE/t with ordinary fuel, %s FE/t with Lava-Infused Coal, or %s FE/t with the higher-tier Lava-Infused Coal. Special coal burns for 50%% of ordinary duration plus 25 percentage points per horizontal lava side, reaching 150%% with four sides. Ordinary fuel receives no lava bonus. Stores up to %s FE and pushes through output-enabled sides.
jei.fastfurnacev2.battery_info: Stores up to %s FE and accepts or supplies up to %s FE/t per enabled side. Configure each side as input, output, or both in the GUI. Retains its exact stored energy when broken and placed again.
jei.fastfurnacev2.power_conduit_info: Transfers up to %s FE/t through each connected network. Mixed-tier networks use the slowest conduit's rate. Right-click to configure fill-first, round-robin, or random ordering and per-connection input/output/both modes. Batteries on the same network do not directly exchange energy.
jade.fastfurnacev2.pending_double: Doubled output is waiting for space
jade.fastfurnacev2.generator_transfer: Transfer: up to %s FE/t per output side
jade.fastfurnacev2.battery_transfer: Transfer: up to %s FE/t per enabled side
